questions.stem: A 66-year-old man in the ICU with septic shock is on mechanical ventilation for 3 days and receiving vasopressors for hemodynamic support. He has no history of gastrointestinal bleeding. Current labs show platelets 48,000/μL, INR 1.7, and creatinine 2.1 mg/dL. He is being fed via a nasogastric tube but is unable to tolerate oral medications. A junior resident suggests continuing only fluids and lactulose due to infection concerns with acid-suppressive agents. What is the most appropriate approach for stress ulcer prophylaxis?

options.label: C
options.text: Administer H₂ blocker in all ventilated ICU patients

options.label: D
options.text: Avoid prophylaxis unless GI bleed occurs
